posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform How AI guardrails are impeding the work of offensive cybersecurity researchers TechCrunch AI · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 1h ago • AI safety guardrails from OpenAI and Anthropic restrict cybersecurity researchers' ability to find vulnerabilities and develop exploitation tools. • Defensive restrictions on language models create friction for legitimate offensive security work that protects systems. • Researchers report guardrails hinder their normal workflow without clearly distinguishing malicious from defensive use cases. 🤖 AI Platform OpenAI won't let some customers export their chats, but this tool will The Register – AI/ML · 🟢 ChatGPT · 5h ago • OpenAI removed chat export functionality for ChatGPT Business and Enterprise customers, unlike free users. • Third-party tools like scrapemychats now fill the gap by enabling data export that OpenAI restricts. • The limitation creates friction for paying customers managing compliance or data portability needs. 🤖 AI Platform One tampered ChatGPT link could spawn a rogue AI agent that took orders from an attacker every five minutes The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 9h ago • AgentForever vulnerability in OpenAI's Agent Builder allowed attackers to create rogue autonomous agents via tampered ChatGPT links. • A malicious link could spawn an agent inheriting the victim's identity and access rights without approval. • The exploit bypassed standard security controls and created persistent threats checking in every five minutes.
